description:
Move the logic of commit resolution, pinned path reads and pinned target inspection from `storage/git_revision.rs` into the git module, and leave `GitRevisionResolver` as a bridge that delegates to it, so the logic exists once and its callers move one at a time.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs` holds `GitRevisionResolver` (repository root plus program; `new` at `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:130`, `with_git_program` at `:138`), `resolve_commit` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:153`), `read_pinned_path` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:170`), `inspect_pinned_targets` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:213`), a `run` helper using `current_dir(repo_root)` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:439-451`), and a write-all-then-read `git cat-file --batch` (`read_blob_batch`, `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:508-606`; parser `parse_cat_file_batch`, `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:640-691`). Its errors are `GitRevisionError` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:25`), re-exported at `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:58`.
- Its users are storage's pinned inspection (`crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:490-504`), the archive planner (`crates/jit/src/commands/archive.rs:190`) and the behaviour suite `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs`.
- The module starts every process with `-C <dir>`. The suite and the storage capture tests count processes with the shared stand-in, which records arguments after that prefix.
- Kept as one change for a convergence reason: moving the logic and making the old type delegate to it are one step, so the logic never exists twice (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout` offers `resolve_commit`, `read_pinned_path` and `inspect_pinned_targets` with today's semantics and results, spawning through the module's helper with `-C` the worktree root, and the module's error type carries `GitRevisionError`'s variants.
- [hard] REQ-02: `storage/git_revision.rs` holds only the bridge: `GitRevisionResolver` keeps its public methods and delegates each to a `GitCheckout` built from its program and root, `GitRevisionError` names the module's error type, and the file starts no process.
- [hard] REQ-03: The behaviour suite, the storage capture tests and the archive tests pass unchanged through the bridge.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Pinned revision reads move into the git module behind a bridge
